name: When should I start planning for aging-in-place renovations?

mainEntity.name: When should I start planning for aging-in-place renovations?

acceptedAnswer.text: It's best to start planning for aging-in-place renovations proactively, ideally before significant mobility challenges arise. Considering future needs while still active allows for thoughtful design and less hurried decisions. Many homeowners integrate these changes during a planned remodel, making the upgrades more seamless. Early planning can prevent urgent, reactive renovations when a sudden health change necessitates immediate modifications.
acceptedAnswer.description: Begin planning for aging-in-place renovations proactively, before urgent needs arise. Integrating these changes into a planned remodel can be a good strategy.
